figures.caption: Figure 1: Overview of the Surrogate Iterative Adversarial Attack (SIAA). In Phase 1, a surrogate Feature-Processing (FP)head is trained to align frozen ViT features with CLIP text embeddings. In Phase 2, a Projected Gradient Descent (PGD) attack is used to optimize a perturbation 𝛿 𝑗 by iteratively shifting the initial adversarial image I𝑗 from the groundtruth cluster toward the target class. This process yields a final adversarial image I𝐽 that bypasses the unknown classification head by exploiting learned feature distributions.
